text:
Hello — two things before I write anything down for this week.

1. I have a note that Diego's CSE451 lecture this week is cancelled, including the Wednesday 10:00 hour. Please confirm that in writing (and say if it is moved rather than cancelled).
2. Please also confirm what I myself have on the schedule Wednesday morning, so I don't put a meeting where I have a teaching duty.

Thank you.

Diego — could we meet for 30 minutes this Wednesday at 10:00? I'd like to go over your progress. If that doesn't work with your own schedule, tell me and I'll offer another slot. I'm waiting on one confirmation from the office before I put it on the calendar.

Good evening.

1. No. CSE451 has **not** been cancelled for this week, and it is not moved either. It stands as scheduled: **Wed 10:00-11:00**. A cancellation or a move counts only when this office announces it in writing to the people concerned, and I have issued no such notice. Please don't record it as cancelled on the strength of a note from elsewhere.

2. I keep the official department schedule, not anyone's personal calendar, so I can't tell you what commitments you personally hold. What is on the official schedule on Wednesday morning is:
- Wed 09:00-10:00 CSE444 lecture
- Wed 10:00-11:00 CSE451 lecture
If your teaching duty is one of those, it takes precedence over a 1:1, and the hours to either side are the ones to look at for meetings. If you tell me which course you teach I can confirm whether it is yours.

If you want anything checked on the schedule, write to me rather than relying on hearsay.

Professor Alvarez — Wednesday 10:00 doesn't work for me: I have the CSE451 lecture 10:00-11:00 that day, so 10:00-10:30 is taken.

Free half-hours on Wednesday: 12:30-13:00 or 15:00-15:30. Thursday 12:00-12:30 and Friday 16:00-16:30 are also free. Any of those suit you?

I'll put it on my calendar and log it as soon as you confirm. (And yes — I'll wait for the office's word before treating anything as moved.)

Thank you — that is exactly why I asked, and nothing goes into my calendar as cancelled.

I teach CSE455. Please confirm the official schedule for CSE455 this week (lectures and office hours), so I know which hours are taken by my own teaching duty; Wednesday morning in particular.

Diego — correcting myself: I had it from a note that your CSE451 lecture on Wednesday was cancelled this week. The office has just told me in writing that nothing has been cancelled or moved, and that CSE451 stands as scheduled Wed 10:00-11:00. So forget my 10:00 suggestion — that hour is taken for you, and it's not mine to move.

Could you give me a slot in your free time this week instead? I'm free Wednesday from 11:00 onward and Thursday and Friday afternoons — tell me which of those suits you and I'll confirm it, office hours and my own teaching permitting.

Confirmed. For CSE455 the official schedule this week lists **one** item:

- **Thu 11:00-12:00 — CSE455 office hours**

There is no CSE455 lecture on the official schedule this week, so nothing of CSE455 is on Wednesday morning: **Wed morning has nothing of yours** — its entries are CSE444 (09:00-10:00) and CSE451 (10:00-11:00), neither of them yours.

Office hours are open to students. For a 1:1 outside them, Thursday after 12:00 and Friday are the clear parts of your week as far as the official schedule goes; I don't keep your personal calendar, so I can't check against that.

For the rest of the week, for your information: Mon 09:00-10:00 TA section, Mon 10:00-11:30 CSE444, Tue 09:30-11:00 CSE452, Wed 09:00-10:00 CSE444, Wed 10:00-11:00 CSE451, Thu 09:00-10:30 CSE452, Thu 11:00-12:00 CSE455 office hours, Thu 14:00-15:30 Seminar, Fri 10:30-12:00 CSE444.

Thanks — that's the right answer, and 10:00 is off the table for good.

Of what you offer, Wednesday 12:30-13:00 is my first choice. One thing before we call it booked: I have to make sure it doesn't run into my own CSE455 lecture or office hours, and I've asked the office to confirm those for this week. Hold it loosely for an hour or so — as soon as they answer I'll confirm (or offer you another slot straight away), and then we both put it on our calendars.

Thanks for checking with the office — noted, CSE451 stands Wednesday 10:00-11:00.

My free time that overlaps with yours:

- Wednesday 12:30-13:00 (my first choice)
- Wednesday 15:00-15:30
- Friday 14:30-15:00
- Friday 16:00-16:30

Say which one and I'll book it and log it. Nothing goes on my calendar until you confirm.

Confirmed from the office: nothing of mine on Wednesday morning, and no CSE455 lecture this week (only my CSE455 office hours, Thursday 11:00-12:00). So **Wednesday 12:30-13:00 works for me** — let's book that.

I'm putting it on my calendar now as a 30-minute meeting with you, Wednesday 18 November, 12:30-13:00. Please log it on yours the same way, and tell me if you'd rather move it to one of your other free slots.
Understood — Wednesday 12:30-13:00 held loosely, nothing booked or logged yet. I'll wait for your word from the office, and if it falls through just offer me another slot.

Then it's settled: **Wednesday 12:30-13:00**, my first choice too. I've logged it — 30-minute meeting with you, Wed 18 November 12:30-13:00. Log the same on your side and we're booked. If anything changes on my side (department business), I'll write to you.
Noted in full — nothing recorded as cancelled, and I'll write to you rather than work from hearsay. Thank you for the schedule.
Booked on my side too: Wednesday 18 November 12:30-13:00, Advisor 1:1 with Prof. Alvarez, and logged. Same here — I'll write if anything changes on mine.
Booked both sides, then. See you Wednesday 12:30. — P. Alvarez
